topic: The Brachistochrone Problem: The Race of Curves

sections.title: Introduction: The Challenge of Descent
lecture_lines: Can we reach the bottom faster?
Not by taking a straight path.
animations: Create title text "Introduction: The Challenge of Descent" in #FFFFFF.
Fade in two beads at A(0, 2) and B(0, 0) on a background curve.
Animate bead A descending a straight line and B descending a cycloid curve simultaneously.
Highlight the faster cycloid path with #FF00FF and label it 'Fastest Path'.
Fade out all elements to transition to next section.

sections.title: Prerequisite Intuition: Energy and Velocity
lecture_lines: Energy dictates speed, gravity drives descent.
animations: Create title text "Prerequisite Intuition: Energy and Velocity" in #FFFFFF.
Display kinetic energy formula K = 0.5 \cdot m \cdot v^2 in #00FFFF at center.
Animate a potential energy bar decreasing while kinetic energy increases on the right side in #FFD700.
Flash the velocity term v^2 in the formula to emphasize its role.
Fade out formula and bar to transition to next section.

sections.title: The Mathematical Reveal: The Cycloid
lecture_lines: A point on a rolling circle.
It traces a path of wonder.
animations: Create title text "The Mathematical Reveal: The Cycloid" in #FFFFFF.
Display MathTex x = r(t - \sin t), y = r(1 - \cos t) in #FFFF00.
Animate a circle rolling along a horizontal line to trace the path.
Flash the cycloid arc in #00FF00 as it is being traced.
Fade out the construction elements to transition to next section.

sections.title: Verification: Why Cycloid Wins
lecture_lines: Straight lines are short but slow.
animations: Create title text "Verification: Why Cycloid Wins" in #FFFFFF.
Create a comparison plot of descent time on a grid.
Display 'Straight Line' in #FF0000 and 'Cycloid' in #00FF00 adjacent in grid cells.
Fade out comparison plot to transition to next section.

sections.title: Real-World Application & Summary
lecture_lines: This birthed the calculus of variations.
Nature uses paths to optimize time.
animations: Create title text "Real-World Application & Summary" in #FFFFFF.
Display silhouette of a diving eagle in #FFFFFF.
Animate the eagle following a cycloidal path downward.
Fade out eagle and title to conclude video.
